review.assessment: The diff only adds invoice.py as a new file with one function: `invoice_total`. The scope of the task requires fixing the billing module so that tax is computed once on the subtotal rather than per line item. This change does not touch taxes.py at all, and no existing invoice.py appears in the diff — only a fresh file. I cannot see what was there before this new file. The added function sums `with_tax(c, rate_pct)` for each individual item, which is exactly the buggy behavior the task describes: tax gets applied and rounded on every line item separately.

findings.actual: 108 (sum of with_tax(33,10) called three times, each rounding independently)
findings.defect: `invoice_total` computes tax individually per item and sums the results instead of computing the subtotal first and applying tax once.
